_help: Campaign hand-ins (Item Trader + objective rewards). Numbers come from the objective window: ISK and LP 'per contribution' (1 contribution = 1 item delivered), and the trader's trade ratio (items per token). Leave per_token null while you don't know it. Type ids because the local SDE doesn't have the new campaign items yet.
_help_tax: turnin_tax: tax taken from the objective's ISK payout (5%). turnin_tax_lp: tax taken from its LP (1%). lp_value: ISK per LP used for hand-ins (the market's value is used when it's lower).
